research_question: Can POLARIS construct a distribution-free, trajectory-level cumulative solar-energy shortfall envelope in Wh that is more defensible than the failed AR variance envelope?

holdout_honesty.year_2023: Prior evidence reference only (exposed in trajectory requalification audit)
holdout_honesty.year_2025: Not a pristine untouched scientific holdout for upstream forecasting (Stage 8.1 metrics previously reported); evaluates out-of-sample transfer of frozen uncertainty representation without tuning

conformal_score.formula: r_i(s, w) = (C_i(s, w) - C_hat_AR_i(s, w)) / max(S_AR_i(s, w), 1.0)

methods.name: V2 AR variance propagation
methods.formula: U_A(s, w) = C_hat_AR(s, w) + z_{1-alpha} * S_AR(s, w)

methods.name: Trajectory-level split-conformal cumulative-energy envelope
methods.formula: U_C(s, w) = C_hat_AR(s, w) + q_hat_cal(alpha) * S_AR(s, w)

pass.subgroup_tolerance: No eligible regime (n>=30) drops > 10% below nominal

inconclusive.condition: Coverage passes but mean envelope width > 2.5x Method B, indicating extreme over-conservatism
